key_insight: CrossRPO rewards answering entire image contrast sets correctly, making evidence-based inspection more valuable than common-sense guessing.
engineering_relevance: This training approach can improve visual agents that must zoom into small, decisive details in ultra-high-resolution images.
method: Create contrast sets sharing one question but differing in a small evidence region and its correct answer.
Use CrossRPO to reward solving the whole set rather than individual answers.
Train ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B on about 3,500 ViRA-Train items each.
evidence_signal: On ViRA-Bench at maximum resolution, CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy versus 59.3% for GRPO; evaluation also includes photographed real-change sets to check against editing traces.
watch_item: Constructing reliable contrast sets requires controlled, answer-changing image variations; performance beyond this benchmark setup remains uncertain.
paper_title: ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization
